hypotheses.justification: This is needed to exclude genus zero. For example, a banana with g = 0 and its single strand of length 1 is a connected genus-zero graph. By `rank_eq_degree_or_neg_one_of_connected_genus_zero`, rank is f(n) = -1 for n < 0 and f(n) = n otherwise, where n is divisor degree. With u = v, `rankDelta` depends only on degree and is f(n) - 2f(n - 1) + f(n - 2), which is 0 for every integer n. Thus the marking is all-submodular even though u = v, so deleting hg makes the theorem false.
